mechanism: Mefloquine can increase CNS toxicity risk and both drugs may have additive neurological effects; valacyclovir requires renal elimination while mefloquine undergoes hepatic metabolism with potential for altered pharmacokinetics.
action: Monitor patients for neurological symptoms including tremors, dizziness, and psychiatric effects; ensure adequate renal function; consider alternative antimalarial if high-dose IV valacyclovir is required.
